**What is the primary reason for initializing pointers to NULL?**","NULL initialization is a defensive programming technique that explicitly shows the pointer doesn't point to valid memory yet. **What fundamental relationship exists between arrays and pointers in C?**","In C, an array name acts as a constant pointer to its first element. **Why are pointers necessary for functions to modify calling function variables?**","C functions use pass-by-value by default, creating local copies of arguments.
